title: Terraform & Infrastructure as Code
description: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, hands-on and cloud-free: HCL syntax, providers & resources, variables/outputs/locals, the state file (drift, locking, remote state), modules & composition, count/for_each, and the plan → apply → destroy workflow with CI. Every challenge runs real `terraform` against local-only providers (local/random/null) — no cloud account or credentials required.
